examples.en: It is not difficult to take up a new career in midlife.
examples.zh: 人到中年开始新的事业并不难。

examples.en: I went through my midlife crisis about four or five years ago, when I was forty.
examples.zh: 在我40岁时，我经历了中年危机。

examples.en: Karl Barth described midlife precisely this way.
examples.zh: 卡尔·巴特正是这样描述中年生活的。
